industry_analysis.culture: Renewable energy adoption driven by policy and economics. Solar culturally accepted in sun-rich regions. Wind energy landscape acceptance varies. Green energy branding increasingly important.
industry_analysis.consumer: Levelized cost of energy (LCOE) drives adoption. Government incentives and feed-in tariffs important. Corporate PPA and sustainability commitments growing. Residential solar adoption increasing.
industry_analysis.infra: IEC/UL certification for equipment. Grid connection standards and codes. Installation and maintenance workforce. Supply chain for critical minerals and materials.
industry_analysis.population: Energy demand growth in developing countries. Urbanization driving distributed energy. Rural electrification through off-grid solar. Green job creation and workforce development.
industry_analysis.social: Climate change urgency driving renewable adoption. Energy independence and security concerns. Community energy and cooperative models. Just transition for fossil fuel workers.
industry_analysis.environment: Lifecycle carbon assessment of renewable technologies. Battery and panel recycling challenges. Land use and biodiversity considerations. Water usage in some renewable technologies.
industry_analysis.opportunity: Energy storage integration and grid services. Green hydrogen production. Floating solar and offshore wind. Emerging market renewable energy deployment.

compliance_summary: IEC standards (61215, 61730, 62109), UL certification (1741, 2703), CE marking, grid connection standards (IEEE 1547), performance certification (TUV, MCS).
